description: Building Footprints – Informal Settlements – Globally distributed, 2002-2017 is a data set deposited in tib.dlr-eoc by its authors Nicolas Kraff, Michael Wurm (German Aerospace Center). This geospatial dataset provides manually mapped building footprints for poverty and informal settlement areas across multiple cities worldwide. The polygons were created by manual visual image interpretation (MVII) from very high-resolution satellite imagery and support urban morphology, deprivation, and remote sensing research. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
